content_zh:
第16章 雪夜抢戏-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》

“大炜，去车上再找一件羽绒服过来。”沈珩也在一旁，他轻声吩咐郭炜。

郭炜回了一句标志性的“好的老板”，转身就往保姆车跑。

他几乎能猜到老板的意图。

果然等他去而复返后，沈珩吩咐：“让斯蒂芬给韩小汐送过去。他比你会说话。”

郭炜：……

憋着嘴去找那个碎嘴的黄毛。

至于斯蒂芬怎么说的，郭炜非要跟过去听听不可——

“穿上，别谢我。”斯蒂芬说着，就直接给韩小汐披上了。

一旁的于清看了一眼，跟着道：“对对对，快穿上，别冻着。”

说完就接着谈工作了。

韩小汐全程连回绝都没有，只配合着套了两只胳膊。

郭炜彻底无语了。

这差事这么简单，他也可以的，好不好！

这边紧锣密鼓的准备着，刘超火急火燎的跑过来。

“导儿，田馨赶不过来，高速封路。”

田馨今天原本请假去参加一个通告，这会儿临时召唤，却赶不回来。

于清听了骂了一句脏话。

但大导演最核心的能力就是运筹帷幄，几乎立即就有了替代方案，“其他镜头先拍。”

他打量了一下韩小汐，立马换上了笑脸，“小汐，待会儿你辛苦一下，帮我拍几个女主的雪中背影。”

韩小汐愣怔，不过还是很干脆的点了头：“好的，没问题。”

嘴上答应了下来，心里则是感慨不已。

人还是得有真本事啊！

同样是给田馨当替身，导演现在跟她说话口气都不一样了呢。

韩小汐很快被拉过去换衣服做妆造。

她不是第一次给田馨当替身，虽然大部分时间是当手替，后面也有过几次和沈珩的牵手戏。

像今天这样全妆的倒是第一次。

于清交代了，说万一有些镜头能用上。

要化妆师务必按田馨的标准来。

韩小汐也第一次尝试到了妆造三小时的待遇。

“放饭了放饭了！”片场助理提着嗓门喊着，“今天沈老师请客，提高餐标。”

小助理的声音带着亢奋，“另外，沈老师还给大家点了糖水，有赤豆元宵，有银耳雪梨。大家加班辛苦了！”

"Da Wei, go to the car and find another down jacket." Shen Heng was also at the side, and he whispered to Guo Wei.

Guo Wei replied with the iconic "good boss", turned around and ran to the nanny car.

He could almost guess the boss's intention.

Sure enough, after he left and returned, Shen Heng ordered: "Ask Stephen to send it to Han Xiaoxi. He can talk better than you."

Guo Wei:......

Holding his mouth shut, he went to find the yellow guy with a broken mouth.

As for what Stephen said, Guo Wei had to listen to it——

"Put it on, don't thank me." Stephen said and put it on Han Xiaoxi directly.

Yu Qing on the side took a look and said: "Yes, yes, put it on quickly, don't freeze."

After that, let’s talk about work.

Han Xiaoxi didn't even refuse the whole process, she just cooperated and tied her arms.

Guo Wei was completely speechless.

This job is so simple, he can do it, okay!

Preparations were in full swing here, and Liu Chao ran over in a hurry.

"Guide, Tian Xin can't make it in time, the highway is closed."

Tian Xin originally asked for leave today to attend an announcement, but now she was summoned at short notice, but she couldn't make it back.

Yu Qing cursed after hearing this.

But the core ability of a great director is to strategize, and he almost immediately had an alternative, "shoot other shots first."

He looked at Han Xiaoxi and immediately put on a smile, "Xiao tide, please work hard later and help me take some pictures of the heroine's back in the snow."

Han Xiaoxi was stunned, but she nodded simply: "Okay, no problem."

He agreed with his mouth, but he was filled with emotion in his heart.

People still have to have real abilities!

She was also acting as Tian Xin's stand-in, but the director's tone of voice when talking to her was different now.

Han Xiaoxi was quickly pulled over to change clothes and do makeup.

This is not the first time that she has been a stand-in for Tian Xin. Although she has been a stand-in most of the time, she has also had several hand-holding scenes with Shen Heng.

This is the first time I wear full makeup like today.

Yu Qing explained it in case some lenses could be used.

The makeup artist must follow Tian Xin's standards.

Han Xiaoxi also tried the three-hour make-up treatment for the first time.

"It's time to serve dinner!" the studio assistant shouted at the top of his voice, "Teacher Shen is treating us today, so raise the price of the meal."

The little assistant's voice was full of excitement, "In addition, Teacher Shen also ordered sweet water for everyone, including red bean yuanxiao and white fungus snow pear. Thank you for your hard work overtime!"
